descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S08 Existing specs: add, edit and delete Important Points persist (Hospital editor, Nursing Home panel)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient with one seeded point; a Nursing Home resident

When Hospital: open the editor; add a point; edit a point in place; delete the seeded point; reload and reopen. Nursing Home: Add Point, Edit point, Save, Delete point

Then The added point is stored with its exact text and source 'manual'; the edited text replaces the original; the deleted point stays gone after reload (Hospital); the Nursing Home point can be added, edited and deleted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions of Tim's specs. Persistence across reload is Hospital only; the Hospital edit and the Nursing Home add/edit/delete are on-screen only (no reload, no backend read); no Save Note in between, so no evidence for U3 or T3 across a Save Note (S02, S07). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S08

Existing specs: add, edit and delete Important Points persist (Hospital editor, Nursing Home panel)

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-12.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — Add Point saves a point and it can be deleted — expected
  • important-points.spec.ts [chromium] — Important Points is nested in the editor and add/delete persist — expected
  • longitudinal-workflows.spec.ts [chromium] — a carried-forward important point can be added, edited, and deleted — expected
  • rounding-workflows.spec.ts [chromium] — an important point can be edited in place — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs important-points.spec.ts, chart.spec.ts, rounding-workflows.spec.ts and longitudinal-workflows.spec.ts): their fixtures are fresh @roundai.test accounts seeded with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
